title: BO-105 Light Twin Helicopter Simulator
summary: Full flight simulator refurbishment and internal R&D testbed featuring motor control loading, tablet glass cockpit instrumentation, curved visual warping, and a VR-immersed motion platform.
highlights: Extracted BO-105 flight dynamics model into an internal R&D lab cockpit with iPad/tablet instrument cutouts.
Engineered electric motor control loading (active force feedback) on cyclic and collective sticks.
Integrated custom motion platform with VR visual immersion to evaluate tactile G-force and acceleration cueing.
